name: Crusoe and Lancium Childress AI data center campus
summary: Crusoe and Lancium announced in July 2026 a grid-connected AI data center campus of 1.0 GW on 270 acres owned by Lancium in Childress, Texas, repeating the partnership model used at Abilene. Lancium owns the land, secures the interconnection and develops the energy infrastructure, including behind-the-meter solar and storage; Crusoe designs, builds and operates the data center for an unnamed hyperscale technology company. Construction was expected to start in the third quarter of 2026, using closed-loop liquid cooling.
